document.title: TRAIN TIMETABLES
document.intro: Choose your travel date from the calendar below, then match the letter shown to the relevant timetable panel. When trains are not running, the “Rail Story” museums and exhibitions at Ingrow Station are usually open.
document.specialKey: S Special Event Timetable, see website for details.
document.footnote: The hours or times stated in the Company's Timetables, Books, Bills and Notices are appointed as those at which it is intended — so far as circumstances will permit — that the trains shall depart from and arrive at the several stations.
